decisions.reason: As a 2023 flagship product line with several models that is close to the firm’s core glass-substrate business and still promoted in 2024, it embodies substantial investment and public commitment, so management is likely to persist rather than admit a strategic mistake.

Although newer and therefore carrying slightly less sunk commitment than A, it was launched in 2024 as a next-generation flagship on its own page and fits the firm’s stated push into higher-value advanced processing, which makes withdrawal within a year unlikely.
